name: Tech Exchange
description: Low-cost refurbished computers with free tech support, plus free computers for digital literacy class graduates
fullDescription: Tech Exchange is a Bay Area nonprofit that provides affordable refurbished computers to individuals, schools, nonprofits, and community organizations, along with free digital literacy classes and tech support.
whatTheyOffer:
- Low-cost refurbished MacBooks, PC laptops, and desktops at the Oakland TecHub store
- Extra discount for households receiving qualifying public benefits (bring proof)
- 1 year of free tech support on computers purchased
- Free computer after completing an 8-hour digital literacy class
- Online store with 15-50% off devices, delivered to your door
- Bulk device orders (10-500) for organizations and businesses
- Device donation drop-off and e-waste solutions
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the TecHub at 1716 Telegraph Ave, Oakland (Mon-Fri 10am-5pm)
2. Bring proof of qualifying benefits for the low-income discount
3. Or shop the online store at techexchange.org
4. Sign up for a free digital literacy class to earn a free computer
5. Organizations: email Tech Exchange for bulk orders
keywords: Tech Exchange, TecHub, refurbished computers, laptops, free computer, digital literacy, nonprofit technology, Oakland, e-waste recycling, Bay Area, low-cost computers
